description: RFC 8098 §2.1 allows an optional list of disposition modifiers after the disposition-type, separated by '/'. Example: 'manual-action/MDN-sent-manually; displayed/error'. In common/mod.rs parse_disposition_field (line 2597), type_part is matched against bare strings ('displayed', 'processed', etc.). If a modifier is present (e.g. 'displayed/error'), the match fails and None is returned, sending the blob to notParsable. No test covers a blob with a disposition modifier. A future maintainer adding modifier support would need to change the split logic; the current code gives no hint this case exists.
title: mdn parse_mdns: disposition modifiers (RFC 8098 §2.1) silently dropped as notParsable
